issues.summary: Valid deeply nested JSON from local model server causes HTTP500 instead of a sanitized failed-attempt result.
issues.reproduction: tests/test_independent03.py::test_independent_nested_model_json_is_reported_as_failure uses a real httpx MockTransport response containing 10,000 nested JSON arrays (20,001 bytes, below 1MiB cap). json.loads raises uncaught RecursionError.
issues.expected: Successful HTTP benchmark response with failed_runs=1, successful_runs=0, null success-only scores and sanitized failure detail.
issues.production_location: app/core.py local_completion JSON decode and analyze adapter exception boundary
issues.resolution: Author now catches RecursionError as a sanitized adapter attempt failure; independent deeply nested response regression passes.

scientific_assessment: Independent deterministic clock test verifies successful adapter latency [1,4]ms with failed attempt excluded, success-only versus all-attempt token F1/exact-match denominators, completion ratio and last successful per-case prediction. A deceptive remote hostname is rejected before transport creation. A malformed nested response previously violated failure accounting and has now been repaired. Author repair for nested JSON independently revalidated: malformed model data now records a failed attempt without HTTP500. The full final suite includes a genuine ephemeral loopback HTTP synthetic model server; this is transport validation, not evaluation of trained model weights.
residual_limits: Built-in baselines are extractive functions, not trained language models. Local model quality depends on operator server and labels.
Maximum 50 cases × 10 repeats × 120-second local timeouts can produce long operator-requested jobs; no overall run deadline is enforced.
